title: AuditEntry
description: A row of the audit_entries table (docs/protocol.md section 7), append-only apart from anchored retention pruning, enforced by SQLite triggers (BEFORE UPDATE / BEFORE DELETE ... RAISE(ABORT)) and a hash chain: entry_hash = sha256(prev_hash || canonical_json(all fields except entry_hash)). The chain seed is a random 32-byte value generated on first run and kept in Keystore-backed storage. phone://audit/recent returns the last 100 rows. Redaction: values for keys named text, body, or message are kept; keys matching token|secret|password|api[_-]?key|authorization (case-insensitive) are replaced with the string "[redacted]". Not every field is populated for every kind (e.g. duration_ms and result_json are meaningless before a tool.outcome row exists) so those columns are nullable rather than omitted, matching a real SQL row where the column always exists.

peer_id.description: Null only for runtime-internal admin rows with no acting peer.

capability.description: The dotted tool/capability name; null for kinds not tied to one capability (e.g. some admin rows).

args_json.description: Redacted call arguments. text/body/message keys are kept; keys matching token|secret|password|api[_-]?key|authorization (case-insensitive) become "[redacted]".

result_json.description: Truncated to 8 KB; null until an outcome is known.

error_code.description: e.g. one of the structuredContent.error codes from section 3.2, when success is false.

idempotency_key.description: params._meta.idempotencyKey when the gateway supplied one.

prev_hash.description: Hex sha256 of the previous row (or the Keystore-held chain seed for the first row).
